route.rationale: prose in four skill files plus the release manifest; no runtime code; small by recorded deviation D5

cells.title: Add the worker-failure rows, the CI-red rule and the PR shape to their skill homes
cells.action: Three prose edits, per pstack-playbook-rules D1, D2, D3; write each in its file's voice, short sentences, no copied pstack prose. EDIT 1 (D1) — skills/bee-swarming/references/swarming-reference.md, section `## Failure responses` (search that heading). Keep the existing five rows. Add rows to the same table: `Silent worker, unsure if stuck` → probe read-only (`bee cells list`, `bee reservations list`, the pane or job record); never resume or re-prompt it to find out — a resume restarts an idle worker. `Context or budget cap hit` → re-dispatch with a smaller scope (split the cell or narrow files). `Transport drop — pane died, connection lost` → re-dispatch the same brief once. `Tool error the worker could not route around` → re-dispatch on a different configured role or transport, with a logged role-reroute decision. `Unknown failure` → one retry, then treat as the two-retries rule. `Late return — a worker reports after its cell was re-dispatched or capped` → reconcile against the current cell state first; salvage a unique finding through a fresh cell, never a blind accept. Then extend the paragraph after the table: after two failed retries the dispatch is abandoned, one postmortem line is written (where: `bee mailbox reflect` or the cap's deviations), and the leader replans around it. Say why in one clause each where the reason is not obvious. EDIT 2 (D2) — skills/bee-herding/references/role-merge.md, near the sentence `CI runs the full declared suite against the merged main on every push` (search it): add one short paragraph headed in the file's style: classify a red CI before any rerun — a flake or infrastructure red earns ONE fresh run of the whole workflow, never a single-job retry; an identical second failure is not flake, read the child log instead of rerunning; a failure in code the diff never touched means a stale base, rebase onto current main before anything else. EDIT 3 (D3) — skills/bee-technical-writing/SKILL.md, at the bullet `PR descriptions and commit messages are writing too` (search it): extend into a short sub-list: title `type(scope): subject`, imperative, no trailing period, a real symbol when one carries the change; body is a one-minute briefing of up to six short sections in this order — Why (1–3 sentences), What changed (1–3 bullets), Scope (what it covers and leaves out), Tradeoffs (only rejected alternatives a reviewer would ask about; skip when none), Blast Radius (who or what it touches and why that is safe), Verification (real run paths and outcomes, one primary number for perf); logs, SHA lists, lane recitals and file-by-file checklists go in a linked artifact, never the body. Then in skills/bee-hive/references/scout-and-ticks.md, in the `**Draft PR, push per cap.**` paragraph (search it), add ONE sentence pointing at bee-technical-writing for the title and body shape — a pointer, never a copy. Do NOT touch skills/bee-planning/playbooks/perf.md (D4). REGEN inside this cell: `.bee/bin/bee dev regen` (it ends with release-manifest --write); commit the regenerated copies with the change, path-scoped.
cells.verify: `rg -c 'Late return' skills/bee-swarming/references/swarming-reference.md` prints 1. `rg -c -i 'flake' skills/bee-herding/references/role-merge.md` prints at least 1. `rg -c 'Blast Radius' skills/bee-technical-writing/SKILL.md` prints 1 and `rg -c 'bee-technical-writing' skills/bee-hive/references/scout-and-ticks.md` prints at least 1. `git diff --stat main -- skills/bee-planning/playbooks/perf.md` is empty. `.bee/bin/bee dev regen` runs clean and `.bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check` is clean.

truths: The failure table names what to do for a silent, capped, dropped, tool-erroring, unknown and late-returning worker, and the two-retries abandonment
The merge role classifies a red CI before any rerun
The PR title and body shape has one home in bee-technical-writing and ship visibility points at it

PR title and six-section body shape
